sources.text:
OSTARA EUROPEAN MID-MARKET FUND II
FUND FACT SHEET
As at 31 March 2025
Period: quarter ended 31 March 2025

Ostara Capital Partners
Strictly confidential — for professional investors only

FUND OVERVIEW

Ostara European Mid-Market Fund II ("Ostara II" or "the Fund") is a 2019 vintage buyout fund investing in control and significant-minority positions in European mid-market companies. The strategy concentrates on business services, healthcare, and specialised industrials, typically with enterprise values between EUR 75 million and EUR 400 million at entry.

The Fund is advised by Ostara Capital Partners. The investment team is led by Managing Partner Clara Voss and Partner Henrik Dahl.

KEY TERMS

Total commitments                                    EUR 1.2 billion
Fund vintage                                         2019
Investment period                                    2019–2024
Geographic focus                                     Western and Northern Europe
Typical holding period                               four to seven years
Management fee                                       1.75% on committed capital during the investment period; 1.50% on invested capital thereafter
Preferred return                                     8%
Carried interest                                     20%

PERFORMANCE

Net IRR since inception                              11.2%
Gross IRR since inception                            14.1%
TVPI                                                 1.48x
DPI                                                  0.41x
Fund NAV                                             EUR 812 million

Returns are presented net of management fees, carried interest, and Fund-level expenses, in euro. Gross IRR is shown before those items. Past performance is not a guide to future results.

PORTFOLIO

The Fund held 34 portfolio companies as at 31 March 2025. Sector mix by NAV is approximately 38% business services, 31% healthcare, and 31% specialised industrials. The five largest positions together represent 42% of NAV.

Remaining value is concentrated in companies that have completed the first phase of operational work and are now compounding earnings.

GOVERNANCE AND REPORTING

The Fund reports to the Limited Partner Advisory Committee each quarter. Valuation is prepared by the manager and reviewed by an independent valuation agent. The next LPAC meeting is scheduled for May 2025.

CONTACT

Investor relations: ir@ostaracapital.example
This document is a summary of Fund terms and performance as at 31 March 2025. It does not constitute an offer to sell, or a solicitation of an offer to buy, any interest in the Fund.

sources.text:
OSTARA EUROPEAN MID-MARKET FUND II
QUARTERLY PERFORMANCE REPORT
As at 31 March 2025
Period: quarter ended 31 March 2025

Ostara Capital Partners
Prepared for limited partners
Strictly confidential

COVERING NOTE

This report sets out the Fund's performance for the quarter ended 31 March 2025. Ostara European Mid-Market Fund II is a 2019 vintage European mid-market buyout fund. Figures below are as at the period end unless stated otherwise.

FUND POSITION

Total commitments stood at EUR 1.25 billion. Fund NAV was EUR 812 million. The Fund held 36 portfolio companies at quarter end, spanning business services, healthcare, and specialised industrials.

Net IRR since inception was 12.4%. Gross IRR since inception was 15.0%. TVPI was 1.51x and DPI was 0.43x. Returns are presented in euro, net of Fund-level fees and carry unless labelled gross.

CASH FLOWS IN THE QUARTER

Realised proceeds in the quarter were EUR 48 million, driven by the partial exit of Helvetic Components AG. Distributions to limited partners in the quarter were EUR 41 million. No new platform investment was completed in the period. Follow-on capital of EUR 9 million was deployed across two existing holdings.

PORTFOLIO COMMENTARY

Earnings across the portfolio were mixed. Healthcare holdings continued to contribute the largest share of NAV. Two industrial positions reported softer order books in the first weeks of the year, which the operating partners are addressing through cost and mix. No portfolio company was written down to nil in the quarter.

Helvetic Components remains a core holding after the partial exit. The remaining stake is carried at a valuation consistent with the transaction multiple on the sold slice, after a liquidity discount.

VALUATION

NAV of EUR 812 million was prepared by the manager and reviewed by the independent valuation agent. Unrealised investments are held at fair value in accordance with IPEV guidelines. Foreign-exchange translation into euro used period-end rates.

LOOKING AHEAD

The investment period has ended. The team is focused on supporting remaining holdings through the next phase of earnings growth and on orderly realisations where exit conditions are constructive. The next report will cover the quarter ending 30 June 2025.

CONTACT

Questions on this report should be directed to ir@ostaracapital.example. This document is for the Fund's limited partners and their advisers only.

The Fund is advised by Ostara Capital Partners. The investment team is led by Managing Partner Clara Voss and Partner Henrik Dahl.
Geographic focus                                     Western and Northern Europe

occurrences.extract: Ostara European Mid-Market Fund II ("Ostara II" or "the Fund") is a 2019 vintage buyout fund investing in control and significant-minority positions in European mid-market companies. The strategy concentrates on business services, healthcare, and specialised industrials, typically with enterprise values between EUR 75 million and EUR 400 million at entry.
The Fund is advised by Ostara Capital Partners. The investment team is led by Managing Partner Clara Voss and Partner Henrik Dahl.
Geographic focus                                     Western and Northern Europe
Management fee                                       1.75% on committed capital during the investment period; 1.50% on invested capital thereafter

The Fund held 34 portfolio companies as at 31 March 2025. Sector mix by NAV is approximately 38% business services, 31% healthcare, and 31% specialised industrials. The five largest positions together represent 42% of NAV.
Remaining value is concentrated in companies that have completed the first phase of operational work and are now compounding earnings.

The Fund reports to the Limited Partner Advisory Committee each quarter. Valuation is prepared by the manager and reviewed by an independent valuation agent. The next LPAC meeting is scheduled for May 2025.
This document is a summary of Fund terms and performance as at 31 March 2025. It does not constitute an offer to sell, or a solicitation of an offer to buy, any interest in the Fund.

This report sets out the Fund's performance for the quarter ended 31 March 2025. Ostara European Mid-Market Fund II is a 2019 vintage European mid-market buyout fund. Figures below are as at the period end unless stated otherwise.
Total commitments stood at EUR 1.25 billion. Fund NAV was EUR 812 million. The Fund held 36 portfolio companies at quarter end, spanning business services, healthcare, and specialised industrials.
CASH FLOWS IN THE QUARTER

Realised proceeds in the quarter were EUR 48 million, driven by the partial exit of Helvetic Components AG. Distributions to limited partners in the quarter were EUR 41 million. No new platform investment was completed in the period. Follow-on capital of EUR 9 million was deployed across two existing holdings.

Earnings across the portfolio were mixed. Healthcare holdings continued to contribute the largest share of NAV. Two industrial positions reported softer order books in the first weeks of the year, which the operating partners are addressing through cost and mix. No portfolio company was written down to nil in the quarter.

Helvetic Components remains a core holding after the partial exit. The remaining stake is carried at a valuation consistent with the transaction multiple on the sold slice, after a liquidity discount.

NAV of EUR 812 million was prepared by the manager and reviewed by the independent valuation agent. Unrealised investments are held at fair value in accordance with IPEV guidelines. Foreign-exchange translation into euro used period-end rates.

The investment period has ended. The team is focused on supporting remaining holdings through the next phase of earnings growth and on orderly realisations where exit conditions are constructive. The next report will cover the quarter ending 30 June 2025.
Questions on this report should be directed to ir@ostaracapital.example. This document is for the Fund's limited partners and their advisers only.

_b602.draftText:
Ostara European Mid-Market Fund II continued to compound in line with the manager's long-term underwriting through the first quarter.

Net IRR since inception stood at 11.2 percent as at 31 March 2025.

The fund held 36 portfolio companies at quarter end.

Total commitments were EUR 1.3 billion.

The fund is a 2019 vintage.

Realised proceeds in the quarter were EUR 48 million, driven by the partial exit of Helvetic Components.

We remain constructive on the remaining portfolio.
